report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned 200 with durations 63-172ms; traces show successful 200s across checkout, order, inventory, payment, redis and postgres with no errors. Metrics show /v1/checkout 200s with zero 502s and p95 ~247ms. No evidence establishes a fault; healthy telemetry contradicts a latency/error hypothesis. Logs were excluded and no baseline exists, so no bounded cause can be substantiated. Handing off.
